name: burger-studio-transformation
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: photorealistic restaurant delivery menu image and before/after website example.
Input image: Image 1 is the actual burger photograph to edit, not a loose style reference.
Primary request: Radically transform the presentation of this actual burger into an appetizing professional DoorDash menu photograph. Replace the entire casual table scene and large white dinner plate with a handsome small matte charcoal ceramic plate on a seamless muted pale blue studio surface and backdrop. Remove all original clutter, cutlery, napkin and glass.
Subject invariants: Retain the unmistakable actual sesame burger and its real portion: the broad sesame-seeded bun, one single thick beef patty, green lettuce, red tomato slices, pale cheese and mayonnaise. Preserve the ingredient order shown: lower bun with mayonnaise and lettuce, thick beef patty, pale cheese and tomato above it, sesame top bun. Retain natural food irregularity and believable proportions; no invented ingredients, extra patties or inflated portion.
Presentation: Professionally tidy and appetizing plating with visible real burger layers. Change the camera to a lower three-quarter angle and center the complete burger on the plate. The transformation should be immediately visible and go well beyond exposure enhancement.
Style: Sophisticated clean commercial food photography with edible, realistic texture and warm golden bun, gently glossy tomato and crisp lettuce.
Lighting: Soft directional studio lighting, shaped highlights, gentle coherent shadows.
Composition: Landscape 3:2, entire burger and entire charcoal plate visible, generous clean cropping margin on all sides.
Avoid: fries, sides, extra ingredients, props, clutter, text, labels, logos, watermarks, plastic food, cartoon rendering.
provenance: AI-edited derivative of the provided burger photo; original author cyclonebill, CC BY-SA 2.0, per parent task source record. Retain original attribution and derivative license when publishing.
